reviews.title: Does not do what it says
reviews.text:
I depended on this app for two years to track my work hours as a contractor — physical labor across 12+ jobs, records I need for taxes, invoicing, and contracts. I paid for the Personal plan, $29.99 a year.

When I went to export my hours, the export screen only lists 5 of my jobs. The rest — with two years of time entries — aren't offered at all. No warning when I signed up, no way to select them, nothing. The app happily records everything, then won't give it back. That's a bait and switch.

The only reason I still have my records: I screen-recorded myself scrolling through the entire log and used AI to rebuild 948 entries into a spreadsheet by hand. That's not a feature working — that's a rescue operation.

If you track more than a few jobs and actually need your data back out, do not trust this app with it.
